name: multi-screen-view
description: Synchronize scrolling, clicks, and navigation across multiple iPhone-sized Chrome windows.

scripts.check: node --check layout.js && node --check devices.js && node --check targeting.js && node --check background.js && node --check content.js && node --check launcher.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json', 'utf8'))"
scripts.test: npm run check && node --test test/*.test.js && npm run store:validate
